title: Hydroponics tech
description: Kept the greenhouse decks alive on a long-haul freighter, and still talks to plants.

title: Salvage diver
description: Cut wrecks apart for scrap in the debris belts. Steady hands, few words.

title: Galley cook
description: Fed a crew of two hundred from a kitchen the size of a cupboard.

title: Field medic
description: Patched up miners after cave-ins on a frontier moon.

title: Planetary surveyor
description: Walked new worlds with a sampling kit before anyone else set foot on them.

title: Station guard
description: Kept order on a crowded transfer station, mostly by being bigger than the trouble.

title: Quarry hand
description: Grew up splitting stone in the terraced quarries of a cold world.

title: Herd keeper
description: Drove shaggy pack animals across high plateaus for a living.

title: Mural painter
description: Covered habitat walls with forests nobody aboard had ever seen.

title: Corridor busker
description: Played for coins in the long corridors of an orbital city.

title: Archivist
description: Catalogued a library of seeds, songs and star charts that no one else read.

title: Tinkerer
description: Fixed anything with a power cell, and several things without.

title: Trapper
description: Lived off the land on a frontier world, selling pelts twice a year.

title: Habitat builder
description: Raised prefab domes on half a dozen new colonies, and saw most of them fail.

title: Orchard child
description: Grew up among fruit trees on an old farming moon, picking from dawn.

title: Ward nurse
description: Worked night shifts on a hospital ship, and never forgot a patient's name.

title: Smuggler
description: Ran cargo past customs cutters. Knows how to keep calm when it counts.

title: Schoolteacher
description: Taught the children of an asteroid town to read, count and look at the stars.

title: Tailor
description: Cut uniforms for a fleet that kept changing its colours.

title: Drifter
description: Never stayed anywhere long enough to call it home. Until now, maybe.

title: Born in the valley
description: Born here, under this sky. The colony is the only home they've known.
